create_health_servicer: create a HealthServicer instance to manage gRPC health check status for services
check_service_health: check the health status of a named service using the async Check method
watch_service_health: watch for health status changes on a service using the async Watch streaming method
set_service_status: set the serving status of a named service to SERVING or NOT_SERVING
enter_graceful_shutdown: enter graceful shutdown mode that sets all services to NOT_SERVING and ignores further status updates
